evidence_required: Three items, each with a validation step.

marking.criterion: First real-host failure mode with a validation step (for example tool output format differences, validated on real captures per OS image)
Second failure mode with a validation step (for example intermittent faults missed by one snapshot, validated by repeated collection and continuous metrics)
Third failure mode with a validation step (for example thresholds or naming that do not match the real fleet, validated by fleet distributions or a known-good baseline)

title: What simulated snapshots cannot reveal
